# preserve technological differences instead of granting every pre-2160 node.

# The legacy effect ID is retained for collapse scripts and old callers,
# but now contains only the minimum common base and transition stockpiles.
ADISCORD_grant_2150_technology_baseline = {
	ADISCORD_grant_technology_profile_common = yes
	# Existing line battalions now require squad fire-support kits.  Give
	# every country a modest transition reserve while AI production catches up.
	if = {
		limit = { num_of_military_factories > 6 }
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment_0
			amount = 400
			producer = ROOT
		}
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = support_equipment_1
			amount = 300
			producer = ROOT
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = ADISCORD_squad_weapons_equipment_0
			amount = 200
			producer = ROOT
		}
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
			type = support_equipment_1
			amount = 150
			producer = ROOT
		}
	}
}
